conditions.C: Stage 3F test-only single-selection mode; no target or admitted claim injected
conditions.D: Stage 3H test-only independent claims; fail closed when a direct obligation has unresolved native alternatives
conditions.computedRequirementContexts: Additional 40-period exact-runner contracts use the same pinned save with only race.iceage or race.truepath set to exercise the native action's route-dependent era selection.
